description: ACT Government Bike & Ride Locations is a dataset listed in ACT Government open data portal (www.data.act.gov.au), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by ACT Government. This dataset outlines the location and details of bike & ride facilities within the ACT. These facilities enable users to use both cycling and public transport modes of travel. Further details on the types of bike and ride locations are available on the Transport Canberra website provided in the metadata. Coverage: Australian Capital Territory. The portal files it under the category Transport. Its tags are bike, bikeshare, bike and ride. The table has 14 columns. Attribution on the portal: Transport Canberra and City Services - Active Travel Office. The portal shows 2018-10-03 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-act-gov-au-portal.
